answer: Sybil farms win if one operator can mint many names and pack a seat window. To enter, a claimant must walk the east jetty to post 14, stand a live falcon lure at the 3.2 m mark, and bind a 32-byte atlas page hash to that post number. Cost is a 29 POA hold plus a 90-minute watch, too slow and dear for one window of clones. Peers re-hash the atlas page against the lure photo and check the post is still occupied. If the jetty post is reused, the falcon lure is cold, or two keys share one atlas page, the hold is slashed to the epoch pool and the seat is void.
